## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Utilities, Industrials, Financials). Confirmation: mixed leadership (top performers span Utilities, Tech, Communication, Industrials) and broad large-cap divergences (several mega-caps BELOW TREND while cyclicals are ABOVE TREND).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.58% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +11.34% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND. Financials positive: JPM (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.50% | 1M: -8.50%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: CMCSA (1W: -8.90% | 1M: -10.29%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples soft: KHC (1W: -9.68% | 1M: -4.68%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -10.45%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +18.48%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -26.69% | 1M: -30.35%) BELOW TREND; SLB (1W: -14.65% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND; CHTR (1W: -13.91% | 1M: -13.19%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -9.51% | 1M: -16.43%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap Tech/Communication and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: VST (1W: +13.16%), INTC (1W: +13.14%), TTWO (1W: +13.14%), AMAT (1W: +12.86%), CAT (1W: +12.27%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: AAPL (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -6.52%) RECOVERY and MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND — this MAJOR DIVERGENCE suggests tactical noise, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed/internal rotation: INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +18.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +50.16%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -12.57%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -10.03%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W -0.47% (24 stocks) — internal rotation, not broad risk-off.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W +1.13% (20 stocks) — cyclical/value tilt confirmed by Industrials strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed/rolling: UNH (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +1.44%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.73% | 1M: +8.17%) CORRECTION; sector 1W -1.81% (17 stocks) — watch for earnings/regulatory headlines to drive idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure (JPM, CAT, COF) while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech names that remain BELOW TREND (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN) and Energy names under pressure (XOM, CVX). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but remain selective given MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +18.48%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -26.69% | 1M: -30.35%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -14.65% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +1.81%, 15 stocks) and Financials (1W: +1.13%, 20 stocks) for continuation. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.81%, 10 stocks) and Communication (1W: -3.36%, 10 stocks) for downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch CAT continuation above recent 1W breakout to confirm industrial leadership; LRCX sustainment above its 1M gains to validate tech-equipment leadership; ACN failure to reclaim any 1W losses would confirm deep BELOW TREND regime; NVDA holding RECOVERY momentum vs. failing to flip 1M to positive would signal a deeper tech pullback.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+85): LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND — AI beat + raised outlook, price confirming accumulation. UNH (+60): UNH (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND — regulatory progress; price consistent with bullish news. TTWO (+55): TTWO (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND — preorder news confirming strong 1W move; VST (+50): VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND — price and research upgrade aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-60): TSLA (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND — safety probe headlines align with downside risk. XOM (-50): XOM (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND — margin/headline pressure and price decline confirm stress. Note: several other bearish headlines (KO, UBER, AMGN) are in the sentiment feed but lack dual-timeframe detail in the provided SP100 snapshot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Style: Value/Cyclical tilt. CAT (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +11.73% | 1M: +40.31%) ABOVE TREND and VST (1W: +13.16% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps (MSFT BELOW TREND vs. AAPL/NVDA RECOVERY) and ACN's plunge warrant tactical caution.
